      "category": "standard",
      "id": "N11",
      "text": "WELDING NOTES - 1) ALL JOINTS SHOULD BE AS PER TABLES “GENERAL WELDING DETAILS” 2) ALL CHILD PARTS TO BE STRAIGHTENED BEFORE WELDING 3) SUITABLE EDGE PREPARATION TO BE DONE BEFORE WELDING 4) FABRICATED STRUCTURE TOLERANCES SHOULD BE AS PER IS 2102 COARSE GRADE UNLESS SPECIFIED. 5) WELDING SHOULD BE NEAT & CLEAN 6) ALL WELDING JOINTS SHALL BE DRESSED PROPERLY 7) MASK MACHINED FACES (IF ANY) DURING PAINTING 8) WELD CLASS - \"B\" 9) STRESS RELIEVING - APPLICABLE 10) SHOT BLASTING - NOT APPLICABLE"
    },
    {
      "category": "standard",
      "id": "N12",
      "text": "INSPECTION NOTES - 1) DYE PENETRATION TEST FOR WELDING - APPLICABLE 2) ULRASONIC TESTING FOR FINISH JOB - NOT APPLICABLE 3) LEAK PROOF WELD JOINT - NOT REQUIRED"
    },
    {
      "category": "standard",
      "id": "N13",
      "text": "GENERAL WELDING DETAILS FOR UNSPECIFIED WELD JOINTS 1) REFER TABLE FOR UNSPECIFIED BEAD SIZE. UNSPECIFIED WELD BEAD SIZES IN mm MIN. WELD LENGTH (MM) WELD CLASS C & D (WELD-PITCH) WELD CLASS B (WELD-PITCH) UPTO 250 FULL LENGTH WELD FULL LENGTH WELD 250 TO 500 50-100 50-100 500 TO 1000 50-150 50-150 ABOVE 1000 100-200 100-200 3) FOR STITCH WELDING, APPLY 25 MM WELD ON END OF WELD SEAM UNLESS SPECIFIED."
    },

      "category": "heat_treatment",
